name: broadbanner-pre-production
description: Pre-Production Assistant (Production+ add-on) for BroadBanner creators. Auto-schedules your shows on Substack and Restream on a recurring basis across every brand you host — the unattended automation of the manual schedule-live skills. Maps to the pre_production_assistant entitlement (cap scheduling:auto). Installs its recurring tasks through the broadbanner-scheduled-tasks engine.
